validation.method: Scan (no text layer): tables read by eye from 200-dpi crops (2 pages per image at 0.64x, out-of-register REQ'D columns zoomed as REF/REQ'D strips); tesseract only as a draft. Shared engine/carburetor/starter pages diffed against A1226 as a cross-check after reading.
validation.refContinuity: All 25 sections continuous from 1 with no gaps. 9 rows printed without a ref number and kept: engine gasket kit, hood L.H. hinge clip (under ref 4), 2 differential sub-items (see Ref. 16 / 21), breaker ignition kit, BR390307 motor, head lamp kit + lights decal, head lamp assembly.
validation.quantities: All rows have a qty; 4 rows are UAR. REQ'D printed out of register on printed pages 23 (belts, brake), 27 (differential) and 29 (PTO, implement lift): mapped in sequence, counts equal row counts, flagged 'inferred qty'.
validation.numericalIndex: Index (printed pp38-40, 518 entries) compared column by column against the transcription in sort order, both directions. All match except: BR 93704 (engine ref 76, muffler screw, p7) is not in the index; C22709 at electrical ref 14 (user-added row) is indexed only at 35/1; 261129 is printed before 261117 (out of sort order); 391461 33B/2 is listed once for two rows (Bosch and Mitsubishi drive assemblies, both ref 2 on 33B). Every hardware entry, including '113 103' (21/22) and '129 102' (29/7) printed without hyphens in the tables, is in the index in hyphenated form.
validation.partNoForms: Briggs BR numbers stored bare (390640), Case letter prefixes closed up (C19012, A27795, T25070, M20677, L32763, F53650, F19633), hardware codes stored 'NNN-NNNN' (221-13). Printed form kept in partNoAsPrinted. Truncated codes '11- 312', '13- 436', '92- 4' kept as printed (index prints the same).
